Pidfile race observed across digest slots 18/20/22/25/26 when launching orchestrator via `nohup npm run … &`: captured PID is the wrapper, not the orchestrator's real Python PID; recovered each time via `ps aux | grep <out-dir>`. Slot 34's direct `nohup training/.venv/bin/python -u … &` invocation did NOT trigger the race (observed at 2m16s, 5m25s, 9m28s into the R7 step 4 run). Working hypothesis: the race is a `nohup` × `npm run` wrapper interaction, not a Python-side bug. Cheap fix candidate: standardise harness launch commands on direct-python invocation + write PID into `<out-dir>/pid.txt` from inside the Python orchestrator before any fork.
